body: chrome-ext settings (apps/chrome-ext/src/app/settings.ts) use dual-layer persistence: chrome.storage.sync FIRST (cross-profile, survives reinstall), IDB key fv:settings fallback; cross-tab live update via chrome.storage.onChanged listener; merge() back-fills missing fields for old shapes. Shape: formats (per-ext render toggle), json{theme,collapsedDepth,...}, shortcuts (per-id enable), shortcutBindings (per-id key override e.g. Mod+KeyK), allShortcutsDisabled. Separate store from the zustand library store.
